---- MODULE SurrealConsistency ----
\* M8.0 T0 — Surreal reconnect / fallback invariants (stub model)
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

VARIABLES connected, fallbackMemory, writes

TypeOK ==
  /\ connected \in BOOLEAN
  /\ fallbackMemory \in BOOLEAN
  /\ writes \in Nat

Init ==
  /\ connected = FALSE
  /\ fallbackMemory = TRUE
  /\ writes = 0

Connect ==
  /\ connected' = TRUE
  /\ fallbackMemory' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED writes

Disconnect ==
  /\ connected' = FALSE
  /\ fallbackMemory' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED writes

Write ==
  /\ writes' = writes + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<connected, fallbackMemory>>

\* When disconnected, fallback memory must be enabled
Inv == connected \/ fallbackMemory

Next == Connect \/ Disconnect \/ Write
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<connected, fallbackMemory, writes>>

THEOREM Spec => []TypeOK
====

---- MODULE DeployWorkflow ----
\* M8.3 T0 — durable deploy saga stub
EXTENDS Naturals

VARIABLES stage

Stages == {"Idle", "Persist", "Deploy", "Done", "Failed"}

TypeOK == stage \in Stages

Init == stage = "Idle"

Advance ==
  \/ /\ stage = "Idle" /\ stage' = "Persist"
  \/ /\ stage = "Persist" /\ stage' = "Deploy"
  \/ /\ stage = "Deploy" /\ stage' = "Done"
  \/ /\ stage \in {"Idle", "Persist", "Deploy"} /\ stage' = "Failed"
  \/ /\ stage \in {"Done", "Failed"} /\ UNCHANGED stage

Inv == stage \in Stages

Next == Advance
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_stage
====
